comment: This is one of the few modules in the plugin that does not call maxPoly: every jack is read with getVoltage and the output is left at one channel. The tempo knob divides by 15 rather than 60 (src/S.cpp:74), so the count between clock pulses runs at four times the beats per minute the knob names; the clock pulses correct it, and the knob only governs how the voltage moves between them. A start arms a transient state by setting the divider to 17 so that the first clock after it always counts (src/S.cpp:94 and 104). The panel prints BPM, DIV, CLK, STRT, STOP, CONT and OUT.
